title: Simplify console list page: design mode toggle + modernized metadata inspector
body:
The console list page had too many visible buttons and the metadata inspector panel was always visible, consuming 30% of screen width. Simplified by introducing a design mode toggle and modernizing the metadata inspector following Linear/Vercel patterns. ## Changes ### Design Mode Separation (NEW) - **Runtime Mode (Default)**: Clean interface for end users - Only "New" button + design tools menu visible - Design tools (Metadata, Edit View, Add View) hidden in dropdown - No metadata panel visible - ~40% reduction in header complexity - **Design Mode**: Developer/designer tools accessible via menu - "Enter Design Mode" menu item - Wrench icon indicates active state - Unlocks: Metadata Inspector, Edit View, Add View - Metadata panel only shows when in design mode ### Metadata Inspector Improvements - **Default state**: Closed (maximizes content space) - **Width**: `w-100` (25rem) → `w-80` (20rem) - **Sections**: Collapsible accordion with first section expanded by default - **Copy**: Clipboard API with visual feedback (Copy icon → Check icon, 2s timeout) ### Visual Design ```typescript // Before: Heavy, always-on debug panel 
...
// After: Light, collapsible inspector (design mode only) 
...
``` ### Implementation - **ObjectView**: Added `designMode` state (default: false), replaced header buttons with DropdownMenu - **MetadataPanel**: State management for `expandedSections` and `copiedIndex`, conditional rendering based on design mode - Fixed: Button nesting HTML validation error - Typography: Improved hierarchy (`text-xs font-semibold`, `text-[11px] leading-relaxed`) ## Screenshots **Before**: Too many buttons, panel always visible **After (Runtime Mode - Default)**: Clean, focused interface **Design Tools Menu**: Progressive disclosure **Design Mode Active**: Developer tools unlocked ## Files - `apps/console/src/components/ObjectView.tsx` - Design mode toggle, simplified header - `apps/console/src/components/MetadataInspector.tsx` - Collapsible sections, copy functionality - `apps/console/docs/UI_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL.md` - Design rationale, future phases - `apps/console/README.md` - Updated features list ## Impact - 40% less visual clutter in runtime mode (default) - 30% less visual noise when metadata panel is used (design mode) - Progressive disclosure via accordion and mode separation - Clear distinction between end user and developer contexts - Developer QoL: one-click JSON copy
